title: KZ Tandingan, Ben&Ben, and Al James join forces for Coke Studio's 'Sumabay Ka'
summary: OPM artists KZ Tandingan, Ben&Ben, and Al James have joined forces for "Sumabay Ka", a song which marks the 10th season of Coke Studio Philippines under the theme "Dinig Ang Pinas."
